op_descriptions.mlp_gate_up: MLP up/gate projection GEMM (or MoE grouped GEMM)
op_descriptions.mlp_act: gated MLP activation (SwiGLU/GeGLU) or dense act
op_descriptions.mlp_down: MLP down projection GEMM (or MoE grouped GEMM)

models.notes: Baseline modern Llama recipe: RMSNorm(pre) + RoPE(theta=10k) + SwiGLU + GQA at scale.
Llama-2 7B: dense MHA (no GQA at this size).
Llama-2 70B: GQA (8 kv heads), SwiGLU.
High-theta RoPE (500k) + Llama3 rope-scaling for 128K ctx; vocab 128k.
Llama-3 8B: GQA(8 kv), 128k vocab, theta=500k.
Llama-3 70B: GQA(8 kv), theta=500k.
Llama-3.1 405B: largest dense Llama; native FP8 serving common.
First Llama MoE; iRoPE (interleaved RoPE / NoPE blocks) for length generalization; routed+shared experts interleaved with dense.
Llama-4 Scout: 16 experts, top-1 + 1 shared, iRoPE.
Distinctive QKV bias term in attention projections; RoPE theta=1e6.
Qwen2 7B: GQA(4 kv) + QKV bias.
Qwen2-MoE: 64 experts top-8 + shared experts; QKV bias.
GQA + QKV bias; high-theta RoPE + YaRN long-context (128K+).
Qwen2.5 7B: GQA(4 kv) + QKV bias + YaRN.
Qwen2.5 72B: GQA(8 kv) + QKV bias + YaRN.
Adds QK-norm; RoPE theta=1e6, YaRN/DCA. 3-Next uses hybrid linear/full attention.
Qwen3 8B dense: GQA(8 kv) + QK-norm.
Qwen3 235B-A22B: 128 experts top-8, no shared; QK-norm; ultra-sparse MoE.
Qwen3 30B-A3B: 128 experts top-8; QK-norm.
GQA + sliding-window attention (4096); RoPE theta=1e6.
Mistral-NeMo 12B: GQA(8 kv), 128k vocab.
Sparse MoE top-2 of 8, SwiGLU experts; GQA (+SWA on 8x7B).
Mixtral 8x22B: 8 experts top-2.
Introduced MLA (low-rank KV compression + decoupled RoPE key) and shared-expert DeepSeekMoE; YaRN.
671B total / 37B active; native FP8 (block-scaled, DeepGEMM); MLA decode w/ matrix absorption; 256 routed + 1 shared top-8 with group-limited aux-loss-free sigmoid gating; MTP.
R1: same arch as V3 (reasoning RL fine-tune); native FP8 block-scaled.
Pre+post RMSNorm; local/global interleaved SWA; attention/final logit soft-capping; GeGLU(gelu-tanh).
Gemma-2 9B: GQA(8 kv), head_dim 256, GeGLU, pre+post norm.
Gemma-2 27B: GQA(16 kv), GeGLU, pre+post norm.
QK-norm replaces Gemma-2 soft-cap; 5 local : 1 global SWA (window 1024); GeGLU; 128K ctx.
Gemma-3 27B: GQA(16 kv), QK-norm, GeGLU.
LongRoPE (SU-scaling) for 128K; Phi-3.5 adds a MoE variant.
Phi-3.5-MoE: 16 experts top-2; LongRoPE.
Llama-style dense recipe (GQA, RMSNorm, SwiGLU) with curated/synthetic-data training.
OpenAI open-weight; GQA(group 8) + learned per-head attention sinks; alternating full / 128-tok SWA; MoE (32 experts/20B, 128/120B; top-4; no shared); native MXFP4 experts.
gpt-oss-20b: 32 experts top-4, attention sinks, native MXFP4.
gpt-oss-120b: 128 experts top-4, attention sinks, native MXFP4.
Llama architecture clone with extended-context (200K) variants; RoPE high-theta.
Yi-34B: GQA(8 kv), Llama-like.
MHA; 7B uses RoPE, 13B uses ALiBi (no rotary).
Baichuan2-13B: ALiBi positional bias instead of rotary.
MQA/GQA; rotary on half-dim (2D/partial RoPE, GPT-J interleaved); QKV bias; GLM-4.5+ are MoE.
GLM-4-9B: GQA(2 kv), partial RoPE (GPT-J interleaved), QKV bias.
GLM-4.5: MoE (160 experts top-8 + 1 shared), sigmoid gating; partial RoPE.
MQA (40B/180B) / MHA (7B); parallel attention+MLP block; LayerNorm; dense GeLU MLP.
Falcon-40B: MQA (8 kv-group), parallel attn+MLP, LayerNorm.
Cohere RAG/tool-use; GQA/MHA, RoPE, LayerNorm, tied embeddings, no bias.
Command-R+ 104B: GQA(8 kv), LayerNorm, tied embeddings.
Partial-rotary RoPE (rotary_pct); LayerNorm or RMSNorm by variant; optional QK-LayerNorm.
ALiBi positional bias instead of rotary; LayerNorm (no bias); dense GeLU.
Partial/GPT-J RoPE (interleaved) + parallel residual; LayerNorm; ancestor of many open recipes.
Fully-open AllenAI; OLMo-2 uses RMSNorm + QK-norm + post-norm (reordered) for stability. OLMo-1 used non-parametric LayerNorm.
OLMo-2 13B: MHA, RMSNorm, QK-norm, post-norm.
